svg.text: SEOP Platform Architecture
Seven pipeline layers · Cross-cutting services · Data foundation · BURR evaluation · CMMI-5 process integration
Pipeline (7 Layers)
L0 · Seed Studio (M01)
Seed contract · CQs · Scope · Upper-ontology commitment · Versioned registry · Human approval
Output: immutable seed ID referenced by all downstream layers
L1 · Ingestion & Context (M15 · M02)
Multimodal ingestion · Real-time + batch · Schema introspection · BURR signals (normalization, FK, N:M, entropy, prompt-length)
Simulation requirement analysis · Draft CQs · Provenance per chunk · DQ quarantine (M16)
Output: structured seed candidates + routing signals
L2 · Seed Extraction (M03 · M04 · M05)
NER · RE · GLiNER · LLM prompts · Candidate classes, properties, instances · Provenance + confidence
Statistical grounding (DB columns, API payloads, ranges) · Hallucination rejection · Disambiguation & canonicalization
Output: grounded, canonical seed candidates
L3 · Synthesis (M06 · M07 · M08 · M41 · M44)
Upper ontology alignment (BFO/DOLCE) · Domain synthesis · Restrictions · Disjointness · Decision chain per axiom
Prompt Strategy Engine (4 tiers) · Mapping Format Generator (R2RML / D2RQ / RML / Direct)
Serialization: Turtle, RDF/XML, OWL Manchester, SHACL/ShEx drafts
Output: candidate TBox + mappings
L4 · Validation (M09 · M10 · M12)
Syntactic · Structural (SHACL/ShEx) · Logical (HermiT/Pellet/ELK) · Quality (OOPS!/OntoClean)
Standards conformance (14+ vocabularies, ISO 21838/29002) · Human Review Gate · Dual review
Output: validated TBox + validation report + human decisions
L4.5 · ABox & CQ Testing (M11)
Instance extraction · Entity resolution · SPARQL CQ execution · Coverage & gap report
Output: populated knowledge graph + functional proof via CQ pass rate
L5 · Evolution (M13 · M14)
Simulation deployment (DT / ABM) · Error monitoring · LLM patch proposals · Impact analysis
Regression testing (BURR) · Human approval · Versioned release · Rollback · Continuous learning loop
Output: evolved ontology version + patch audit trail
Feedback Loop
Cross-Cutting Services
Data Foundation (M15–M20)
M15 Ingestion · M16 Quality · M17 Dictionary · M18 Lifecycle
M19 Governance · M20 Metadata & Ontology
BURR signals: normalization, FK, N:M, entropy, naming drift
DQ gates · Canonical naming normalizer · Lineage
Approved terms → M17 → M40 lexical scoring
Metadata catalog → M20 → M39 benchmark artifacts
CMMI-5: business glossary at Level 5 includes ontology structures
Enterprise Foundation (M26–M31)
M26 RBAC & IAM · M27 Provenance & Audit · M28 Registry & Versioning
M29 Evaluation Harness · M30 Security & Compliance · M31 LLM Orchestrator
Provenance: PROV-O decision chain per element · prompt tier · model · reviewer
Registry: SemVer · diff · rollback · BURR scores archived per version
Security: SOC 2 · ISO 27001 · GDPR · HIPAA · PII redaction
LLM Orchestrator: prompt versioning · cost control · fewshot injection
BURR Evaluation Suite (M39–M46)
M39 Benchmark Harness · M40 Dual-Metric Engine · M41 Prompt Strategy
M42 Model Routing · M43 Hybrid Ensemble · M44 Mapping Format
M45 Scenario Library · M46 Statistical Rigor Service
Dual metrics: lexical F1 + mapping F1 per element (C/R/A)
Hallucination detection: high lexical / low mapping
Bootstrap CI · Nemenyi · CD diagrams · significance gate
R2RML default · D2RQ · RML · Direct Mapping
Regression gate for M14 patch approval
CMMI-5 Process Areas (M32–M38)
M32 OPP · M33 QPM · M34 CAR · M35 DAR
M36 CM · M37 PPQA · M38 MA
MA (M38): BURR metric stream is primary measurement source
QPM (M33): SPC control charts on BURR F1
CAR (M34): root cause on BURR score drops
DAR (M35): formal model/prompt promotion decisions
CM (M36): scenarios and mappings are baselines
Enterprise Consumers
Agentic AI runtime: SPARQL / GraphQL · ontology-driven tool selection
Digital Twin platform: semantic simulation · KPI drift monitoring
BI & Analytics: dashboards · BURR scorecards · statistical reports
External APIs: SPARQL 1.1 · GraphQL · REST · webhooks · Kafka
Standards-conformant exports: R2RML / D2RQ / RML
RBAC enforced at gateway (M26)
Standards · Compliance · Provenance
BFO · DOLCE · ISO/IEC 21838 · ISO 29002 · R2RML · D2RQ · RML · Schema.org · DCAT · DCTERMS · SKOS · PROV-O · GeoSPARQL · WGS84 · SSN · SOSA · SAREF · FIBO
CMMI Level 5 (Continuous Representation) · SOC 2 · ISO 27001 · GDPR · HIPAA · SPARQL 1.1 · OWL 2 · SHACL · ShEx · 100% provenance coverage
SEOP · Platform Architecture v1.0
